indicator_version_standard_population_de.name: indicator_version_standard_population_detail_check
indicator_version_standard_population_de.value: "indicator_version"."standard_population_detail" IS NULL OR "indicator_version"."standard_population" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR "indicator_version"."value_type_id" IN ('01a0d8a5-3ca2-7315-bfca-96cc2dc711c3', '01a0d8a5-3ca2-7315-bfca-96cda63ea940')

indicator_version_standard_population_ot.name: indicator_version_standard_population_other_check
indicator_version_standard_population_ot.value: "indicator_version"."standard_population" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR "indicator_version"."standard_population_detail" IS NOT NULL

indicator_version_unit_detail_check.name: indicator_version_unit_detail_check
indicator_version_unit_detail_check.value: ("indicator_version"."unit_detail" IS NOT NULL) = ("indicator_version"."unit_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '01a0d8a5-3ca2-7315-bfca-96e5cee57158')

indicator_version_calculated_by_detail_c.name: indicator_version_calculated_by_detail_check
indicator_version_calculated_by_detail_c.value: ("indicator_version"."calculated_by" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'other') = ("indicator_version"."calculated_by_detail" IS NOT NULL)

indicator_version_disclosure_control_det.name: indicator_version_disclosure_control_detail_check
indicator_version_disclosure_control_det.value: ("indicator_version"."disclosure_control" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'yes') = ("indicator_version"."disclosure_control_detail" IS NOT NULL)

indicator_version_goal_upper_value_check.name: indicator_version_goal_upper_value_check
indicator_version_goal_upper_value_check.value: "indicator_version"."goal_upper_value" IS NULL OR ("indicator_version"."goal_lower_value" IS NOT NULL AND "indicator_version"."goal_upper_value" > "indicator_version"."goal_lower_value")

indicator_version_specific_age_type_chec.name: indicator_version_specific_age_type_check
indicator_version_specific_age_type_chec.value: ("indicator_version"."age_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'specific') = ("indicator_version"."specific_age" IS NOT NULL)

indicator_version_age_detail_check.name: indicator_version_age_detail_check
indicator_version_age_detail_check.value: ("indicator_version"."age_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'other') = ("indicator_version"."age_detail" IS NOT NULL)

indicator_version_year_type_period_check.name: indicator_version_year_type_period_check
indicator_version_year_type_period_check.value: ("indicator_version"."year_type" IS NOT NULL) = ("indicator_version"."period_type" IS NOT NULL AND "indicator_version"."period_type" IN ('years', 'quarters'))

indicator_version_year_end_check.name: indicator_version_year_end_check
indicator_version_year_end_check.value: ("indicator_version"."year_end_day" IS NOT NULL) = ("indicator_version"."year_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'specified-end-date') AND ("indicator_version"."year_end_month" IS NOT NULL) = ("indicator_version"."year_end_day" IS NOT NULL)

indicator_version_year_end_date_check.name: indicator_version_year_end_date_check
indicator_version_year_end_date_check.value: "indicator_version"."year_end_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "indicator_version"."year_end_day" BETWEEN 1 AND CASE WHEN "indicator_version"."year_end_month" = 2 THEN 29 WHEN "indicator_version"."year_end_month" IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END

indicator_version_data_table_confirmed_c.name: indicator_version_data_table_confirmed_check
indicator_version_data_table_confirmed_c.value: "indicator_version"."data_table_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "indicator_version"."upload_batch_id" IS NOT NULL

indicator_version_age_range_limit_check.name: indicator_version_age_range_limit_check
indicator_version_age_range_limit_check.value: "indicator_version_age_range"."lower_limit" IS NOT NULL OR "indicator_version_age_range"."upper_limit" IS NOT NULL

indicator_version_age_range_order_check.name: indicator_version_age_range_order_check
indicator_version_age_range_order_check.value: "indicator_version_age_range"."upper_limit" * CASE "indicator_version_age_range"."upper_limit_unit" WHEN 'days' THEN 1 WHEN 'weeks' THEN 7 WHEN 'months' THEN 30.4375 WHEN 'years' THEN 365.25 END >= "indicator_version_age_range"."lower_limit" * CASE "indicator_version_age_range"."lower_limit_unit" WHEN 'days' THEN 1 WHEN 'weeks' THEN 7 WHEN 'months' THEN 30.4375 WHEN 'years' THEN 365.25 END

indicator_version_submission_ended_check.name: indicator_version_submission_ended_check
indicator_version_submission_ended_check.value: ("indicator_version_submission"."status" IN ('withdrawn')) = ("indicator_version_submission"."ended_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("indicator_version_submission"."ended_by" IS NULL) = ("indicator_version_submission"."ended_at" IS NULL)

public.current_published_version.definition: select distinct on ("indicator_version"."indicator_id") "id", "indicator_id" from "indicator_version" where "indicator_version"."status" = 'published' order by "indicator_version"."indicator_id" asc, "indicator_version"."published_at" desc, "indicator_version"."id" desc
public.current_published_version.name: current_published_version
